title: Tourism recommender (Capstone 2, Part 2)
one_liner: Explores 437 Indonesian tourist spots and 10k user ratings, then recommends places to a known user or to someone who only states a category, city and budget, with a reason for every pick.

steps.text: Capstone 2, part 2: recommendations for user 1 on the hybrid route, shown on load
Or describe your interests: nature preserve, Bandung, budget Rp 20,000
Find places: content-based ranking with a reason for every pick
Findings and charts: the EDA behind the engine
Who rates: the age distribution of the 300 users
What is on offer: categories and each city's speciality
The ratings carry almost no signal: near-uniform 1 to 5, 0.008 correlation with the public rating
So collaborative filtering sits at the baseline; the content route is what carries the recommendations
